headline: China's CSI 300 Slips Into Bear-Market Territory Amid AI Sector Rout
summary: China's benchmark CSI 300 Index slid into bear-market territory as an ongoing correction in artificial intelligence and technology shares deepened across regional exchanges.
why: Broad market corrections in major regional equity indices reflect declining investor confidence and sector-specific asset liquidations.

impacts.name: Chinese Equities
impacts.why: Widespread selling across high-valuation technology and AI stocks pushes major indices down into bear-market territory.

why_moved: Deepening routs in high-flying artificial intelligence and technology stocks drove broad-based liquidations across Chinese exchanges.
